name: affine-connector
description: Single full-surface AFFiNE connector for ChatGPT with native MCP passthrough, connector-managed AFFiNE sessions, API access and document lifecycle operations.

interface.shortDescription: Use AFFiNE MCP, API and document lifecycle through one connector.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT connects only to the Bratonien AFFiNE connector. The connector forwards all native AFFiNE workspace MCP tools dynamically and internally manages the authenticated AFFiNE session needed for same-origin API and sync lifecycle operations such as trash, restore and permanent deletion.
defaultPrompt: Update or delete this AFFiNE document for me.
